strategy.skills: generate: build.py --pack <name> creates build/<pack>/skills/<name> symlinks into the core for the selected skills
strategy.agents: generate: build.py merges ../../agents/*.md with overrides/*.yaml into build/<pack>/agents/
strategy.shared: generate: build.py links build/<pack>/shared/references to ../../shared/references, beside the skills, so that a skill's ../../shared/references/<file> resolves by the installed path

install: install.sh [--pack <name>] builds and symlinks build/<pack>/ to ~/.claude/skills/openhora

secrets.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: the strong model's eval runs and gradings inside the eval container, where the CLI's login and the keychain do not exist
secrets.permission: a long-lived token of the maintainer's own account, made with the CLI's setup-token command
secrets.note: in an eval run the value never enters the run container: the strong model's key proxy (evals/container/keyproxy/) holds it and adds it to each call, and the run gets a placeholder and the proxy's address in ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL

secrets.name: CLAUDE_CODE_WEB_API_KEY
secrets.purpose: the strong model's eval runs of the cases that use the open network (web_cases of evals/eval-gate.json), in place of the account's token, only when the gate file lists it in strong_web_pass_env; today it does not, and those runs use the account's token through the strong model's key proxy
secrets.permission: an API key of the model's provider with a low spend limit, used for evals only: a run on the open network reads pages written by others, and a leak then costs at most the key's limit
